title: CFD methods and algorithms review scorecard

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: 2-D compressible perfect-gas conservative equations and coefficient conventions source/report-supported.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: TRI_3/QUAD_4 multizone mesh supported; CGNS MIXED section unsupported.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: Conservative face residual and global norms implemented; transient inner updates recompute gradients and residual.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: Rusanov flux and low-Mach diagnostics present; no independent shock verification.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: Farfield, slip and no-slip adiabatic paths with wall-boundary output semantics.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: LSQ/limiter with positivity fallback; first-order diagnostic controls exist without established production use.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: Limiter and diagnostic first-order switches implemented; selected production launch has no explicit switches, inherited environment unbound.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: solver.cpp:847–861 integrates full traction despite tangential-only report claim; normal contribution not quantified.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: LU-SGS and Newton–Krylov stall fallback exist; M015/M2 residual stops precede stable forces.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: BDF2 frozen histories and recomputed inner total residual present; historical binary unbound, original force evidence near settled only at late time.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: Root-only mesh, METIS owned/ghost, halos and reductions. Retained rank-study drags close; exact binaries unbound.

disqualification_flags.flag: Solver uses explicit time stepping only
Report claims second-order reconstruction or limiter that is disabled in production
metadata.json claims METIS/ParMETIS but code uses geometric split or full-state replication
Re 200 run reaches final time but misses inner target on most steps (failed transient solve presented as periodic)
Normal viscous traction mislabeled as skin friction
Surface no-slip rows are actually adjacent cell-center velocities without documentation
